sitewide.translation_message: This application is translated by users like you! If you see items that are not translated (or have suggestions for improvements!) please suggest improvements on GitHub.
sitewide.tab_container_sr_text: Select a group of settings to edit

sender.wifi_disagreements_tooltip: Spells where the Wi-Fi library reported 'disconnected' while the network interface was demonstrably up. Uploads continue during these, because the firmware trusts the interface over the library - so a short episode is harmless. This previously reported a per-poll counter, which made one minute look like thousands of faults.
sender.last_recovery_line: The device restarted itself because the {reason} (target at the time: {target}).
sender.last_recovery_detail: Heartbeat age {heartbeat}, send lock age {lock}, uptime at restart {uptime}, boot count {boot}.
sender.load_failed: Unable to read sender status from the TiltBridge.

reset_actions.description: These actions will reset parts of your TiltBridge configuration. Use with caution.

reset_wifi.title: Reset WiFi Settings
reset_wifi.description: Clear WiFi credentials and return to setup mode. The device will restart and create its own WiFi access point.

reset_device.title: Reset Device
reset_device.description: Perform a complete factory reset. Everything stored on the device is erased: all settings, WiFi credentials, per-Tilt configurations (names, sheet names and calibration) and any readings still waiting in the offline queue.

wifi.title: Confirm WiFi Reset
wifi.message: Are you sure you want to reset the WiFi settings? The device will restart and you will need to reconnect to its setup network to reconfigure WiFi.

device.title: Confirm Device Reset
device.message: Are you sure you want to perform a factory reset? This erases every setting, your WiFi credentials, every per-Tilt configuration including calibration, and any readings still queued for upload. Queued readings have not reached your targets yet and cannot be recovered. This action cannot be undone.

wifi.title: Resetting WiFi...
wifi.message: The device is resetting WiFi settings and will restart. You will need to connect to the TiltBridge setup network to reconfigure WiFi access.
wifi.success_message: The WiFi reset command was accepted. The device will restart shortly. You will need to connect to the TiltBridge setup network to reconfigure WiFi access.
wifi.failed_message: The WiFi reset command could not be sent. Please check your connection to the device and try again.

device.title: Resetting Device...
device.message: The device is performing a factory reset and will restart. All settings, per-Tilt configurations and queued readings have been erased. You will need to reconfigure the device (including WiFi access) from scratch.
device.success_message: The factory reset command was accepted. The device will erase everything and restart shortly. You will need to reconfigure the device (including WiFi access) from scratch.
device.failed_message: The factory reset command could not be sent. Please check your connection to the device and try again.

device_config.config_failed_error: Configuration failed to load from TiltBridge. Try refreshing the page, or check your TiltBridge's connection to the network.
device_config.mDNS_id_desc: Host name (the xxxx in http://xxxx.local/). Must be 1-31 characters.
device_config.tz_offset_desc: Time Zone Offset from GMT (in hours). Used for Google Sheets.
device_config.smooth_factor_desc: Valid range is 0 to 99. Setting affects time constant of exponentially weighted moving average filter applied to specific gravity reading. In response to a step change, the filtered value should reach steady state after ~ 5 time constants. A setting of 0 gives no smoothing (filtering off) while higher values mean more smoothing.  A setting of 60 gives time constant of just over 5 seconds while 99 results in ~ 5 minutes.
device_config.invert_tft_desc: - Use if the screen is upside-down
device_config.combine_tilts_name: Combine Tilts of the same color
device_config.combine_tilts_desc: Combines all readings received from Tilts of the same color, and overwrites their unique identifiers with the MAC address of this TiltBridge. Use this if you use Tilt "repeaters" to prevent duplication of the same Tilt.

errors.mdns_invalid_chars: mDNS ID can only consist of the letters a-z, a hyphen, or numbers, and must not start or end with a hyphen
errors.mdns_invalid_length: mDNS ID must be between 1 and 31 characters
errors.invalid_smoothing_factor: Specific gravity smoothing factor must be between 0 and 99
errors.invalid_tz_offset: Timezone offset must be between -12 and 14

update_modal.fail_message: Unable to connect to the TiltBridge or the update was rejected. Please recheck the information provided and reattempt.

fermentrack.target_type_desc: Select the type of system you want to send to
fermentrack.push_frequency_out_of_range: Push frequency must be a number between {min} and {max}
fermentrack.url_invalid: URLs must start with either http:// or https://
fermentrack.reset_device_id_msg: Delete device ID and re-register with upstream. Warning - cannot be undone!
fermentrack.hostname_too_long_error: Hostname is invalid. Must be less than 127 characters.
fermentrack.port_out_of_range_error: Port number must be between 10 and 65535 (but is typically 80)

presets.no_fermentrack_desc: Do not use TiltBridge with Fermentrack 2
presets.fermentrack_net_desc: Use Fermentrack.net to control this TiltBridge
presets.fermentrack_local_desc: Use a local Fermentrack 2 instance to control this TiltBridge

errors.error_port_out_of_range: Port must be a number between 1 and 65535
errors.missing_data_error: There was data missing in the registration message which is typically set internally by the TiltBridge. This most likely means that either the TiltBridge firmware or the version of Fermentrack is out of date. Please update the TiltBridge firmware and/or Fermentrack and try again.
errors.invalid_username_error: Username is invalid on the targeted Fermentrack install. Please check the username and try again.
errors.bad_api_key_error: API Key does not match a valid brewhouse on the targeted Fermentrack install. Please enter a valid username and try again.
errors.missing_brewhouse_error: The specified Fermentrack user does not have a brewhouse. Please complete setup of this user in Fermentrack and try again.
errors.no_username_error: No username or API key specified.
errors.waiting_to_register_error: Device is waiting to register with Fermentrack. Please wait up to 3 minutes and refresh this page.
errors.unable_to_reach_fermentrack_error: TiltBridge is unable to reach Fermentrack. Please check that Fermentrack is accessible at the specified hostname/port.
errors.successful_registration_msg: TiltBridge is successfully registered with Fermentrack
errors.unknown_error: An unknown error was sent by Fermentrack. This most likely means that either the TiltBridge firmware or the version of Fermentrack is out of date. Please update the TiltBridge firmware and/or Fermentrack and try again.

google_sheets.url_desc: URL of the target Google Script
google_sheets.email_desc: Email address used to create the targeted script
google_sheets.color_sheet_tilt_name_desc: The spreadsheet name to place data for the {color} tilt on
google_sheets.v2_enabled: Use the v2 Google Sheets protocol
google_sheets.v2_enabled_desc: Sends the capture time with each reading so backlogged readings land under the time they were taken rather than the time they were uploaded. Requires an updated Apps Script.
google_sheets.push_frequency_desc: How often a reading is uploaded to the spreadsheet. Not the offline queue's snapshot interval, which is set on the Queue page. Google's Apps Script quotas make anything under 10 minutes unusable.

brewers_friend.about_text: These settings control how TiltBridge talks to Brewer's Friend. With a premium account, Brewer's Friend supports logging from gravity sensors such as the Tilt Hydrometer. To find your API key, log into your Brewer's Friend account and go to Profile > Account. Your API key will be a string of letters and numbers (not a URL).
brewers_friend.api_key_desc: API key from your Brewers Friend account settings
brewers_friend.error_api_key_too_short: API key must be greater than 12 characters

brewfather.about_text: These settings control how TiltBridge talks to Brewfather. With a premium account, Brewfather supports logging from gravity sensors such as the Tilt Hydrometer. To find your API key, log into your Brewfather account and go to Settings > Custom Stream. Your Stream key will be a string of letters and numbers (not a URL).
brewfather.api_key_desc: Stream key from your Brewfather account settings
brewfather.error_invalid_stream_key: Stream key is a series of letters and numbers - not a URL. Please check the key and try again.
brewfather.error_api_key_too_short: Stream key must be greater than 5 characters

grainfather.about_text: These settings control how TiltBridge talks to Grainfather. Grainfather supports logging from gravity sensors such as the Tilt Hydrometer with an account. To find your API url, log into your Grainfather account and go to Equipment > Fermentation Devices. Add a "Tilt" fermentation device for each color Tilt you want to log. After adding the Tilt, the URL required below can be found under setup instructions (accessible by clicking the circled "i" next to the Tilt in Grainfather).
grainfather.grainfather_url_desc: Enter the Grainfather URL for your {color} Tilt Hydrometer

brewstatus.about_text: These settings control how TiltBridge talks to BrewStatus. To disable pushing to BrewStatus, delete the BrewStatus URL.
brewstatus.brewstatus_url_desc: Brewstatus URL to push tilt data to for your account

taplist_io.about_text: These settings control how TiltBridge talks to Taplist.io. To disable pushing to Taplist.io, delete the Taplist.io URL.
taplist_io.taplistio_url_desc: Taplist.IO URL to push tilt data to for your account

mqtt.about_text_1: These settings control how TiltBridge publishes data to an MQTT Broker. To disable pushing to the MQTT broker, delete the MQTT Broker IP.
mqtt.about_text_hast: MQTT implementation supports Home Assistant Auto Discovery of temperature and specific gravity sensors.
mqtt.about_text_payload_header: General message payload is JSON and is formatted as follows
mqtt.broker_address_desc: Enter the MQTT broker server address (Hostname or IP)
mqtt.mqtt_topic_desc: The MQTT topic to publish data to
mqtt.mqtt_push_every_desc: How often to push data (in seconds)

generic_target.about_text: This target allows you to send a generic JSON payload containing your Tilt data to a service that TiltBridge otherwise does not support
generic_target.generic_target_url_desc: The URL to which to push a payload containing JSON data covering your Tilts

influxdb.about_text: These settings control how TiltBridge sends data to InfluxDB v2. You'll need an InfluxDB v2 instance and an API token with write permissions to the specified bucket. To create a token, log into your InfluxDB instance and go to Data > API Tokens.
influxdb.url_desc: Full URL to your InfluxDB v2 server (e.g., https://us-west-2-1.aws.cloud2.influxdata.com)
influxdb.token_desc: InfluxDB v2 API token with write permissions to the specified bucket
influxdb.bucket_desc: InfluxDB bucket name where Tilt data will be stored
influxdb.push_frequency_desc: How often to send data to InfluxDB (recommended: 900 seconds / 15 minutes)
influxdb.error_invalid_url: Please enter a valid URL starting with http:// or https://
influxdb.error_invalid_push_frequency: Push frequency must be between 60 and 86400 seconds (1 minute to 24 hours)

push_interval.label: Push Frequency
push_interval.label_desc: How often a reading is uploaded to this target.

wifi.signal_range_value: avg {average}, min {minimum}, max {maximum} dBm over {samples} samples in the last {window}
wifi.access_point_hint: The BSSID of the radio this device is attached to. On a network with a repeater the SSID is shared, so this is the only field that tells the repeater and the router's own access point apart.
wifi.roams_hint: Times the access point changed under this device. On a repeated network a high count means it keeps being handed between the repeater and the router, which costs a reconnect each time even when the signal looks strong.
wifi.recoveries_hint: Attempts to move off a weak access point onto a materially stronger one on the same network. These moves are deliberate, so they are not counted as dropouts. NO_CANDIDATE means the scan found nothing better and SAME_AP means the reconnect came back to the same radio - both healthy outcomes that changed nothing. REASSOC_TIMEOUT means the link had not returned when the wait ran out.
wifi.tooltip: Average {average} dBm, min {minimum} dBm, max {maximum} dBm over {samples} samples in the last {window}. {outages} dropout(s) since boot.
wifi.tooltip_offline: Not connected to WiFi. {outages} dropout(s) since boot. Readings are being queued to flash.
wifi.desynced_title: WiFi manager is out of sync with the interface
wifi.desynced_detail: The device is associated with an access point, but its WiFi manager reports being disconnected. Uploads keep working because the firmware trusts the interface over the manager, but /api/wifi/status reads blank meanwhile. The firmware drops the association to resynchronise it after five minutes.
wifi.desynced_for: Out of step for {age}; {episodes} episode(s) since boot.

tilt_list.rssi_tooltip: Average {average} dBm, min {minimum} dBm, max {maximum} dBm over {samples} samples
tilt_list.configure_button_unconfigured: Configure this Tilt (currently using the shared color settings)
tilt_list.combine_tilts_notice: "Combine Tilts of the same color" is enabled, so readings from same-color Tilts are merged into one entry and per-device configuration is unavailable. Turn it off in General Settings to configure each physical Tilt separately.

tilt_device_config.description: These settings are attached to this physical Tilt (by MAC address), not to its color. Anything left blank falls back to the shared color settings.
tilt_device_config.friendly_name_desc: Name shown in the Tilt list and sent to targets that support it. Maximum 32 characters.
tilt_device_config.gsheets_name_desc: Spreadsheet tab name used for this Tilt. Overrides the color-wide sheet name. Maximum 25 characters.
tilt_device_config.model_label_desc: Overrides the automatically detected model. Leave blank to keep the detected value. Maximum 16 characters.
tilt_device_config.notes_desc: Free-form note for your own reference. Maximum 64 characters.
tilt_device_config.alias_desc: MAC address of a repeater that rebroadcasts this Tilt. Readings from the alias are treated as coming from this device. Optional.
tilt_device_config.enabled_desc: When unchecked, this Tilt stays visible in the list but its readings are not sent to any target.
tilt_device_config.calibration_link_desc: Opens the calibration page for this specific device rather than for the whole color.
tilt_device_config.reset_desc: Deletes this device's stored configuration. The Tilt keeps reporting, but goes back to using the shared settings for its color.

errors.missing_device_id: This Tilt has no MAC address, so per-device settings cannot be saved. Update the TiltBridge firmware.
errors.friendly_name_too_long: Friendly name must be 32 characters or fewer
errors.gsheets_name_too_long: Google Sheets name must be 25 characters or fewer
errors.model_label_too_long: Model label must be 16 characters or fewer
errors.notes_too_long: Notes must be 64 characters or fewer
errors.invalid_alias: Repeater aliases must be MAC addresses in the form 88:C2:55:AC:26:81

status.description: Readings captured while the TiltBridge could not reach its targets are stored on the device and uploaded once the connection returns.
status.queue_disabled: Disabled - readings are not being stored while offline
status.unhealthy: The queue file could not be read or written. Check the device storage.
status.dropped_warning_title: {count} readings were discarded because the queue was full
status.dropped_warning_desc: Raise the maximum queued records, shorten the snapshot interval, or fix the connection to the send target. The count resets when the queue is cleared or the device restarts.
status.time_not_valid_desc: The device clock has not been set, so readings queued now are marked TimestampValid: false and will be uploaded without a trustworthy capture time.
status.action_failed: The TiltBridge rejected that action. Please try again.
status.load_failed: Unable to read queue status from the TiltBridge.

clear_modal.title: Permanently delete queued readings?
clear_modal.message: {count} stored readings will be permanently destroyed and can never be uploaded.
clear_modal.irreversible: This cannot be undone. If you only want to retry the upload, use "Send backlog now" instead.
clear_modal.acknowledge: I understand that {count} readings will be permanently deleted

settings.description: Two independent knobs: how often the queue is written to flash, and how much it can hold.
settings.interval_group_desc: How often TiltBridge captures a reading from each Tilt and writes it to flash. This is the sampling rate: it decides how many rows reach your spreadsheet, and how much a sudden power cut can lose. Sampling more often also consumes flash write cycles faster.
settings.snapshot_interval_desc: How often a reading is captured and stored. Not the same as a target's push frequency, which only decides how long a captured reading waits before being uploaded.
settings.custom_interval_desc: Valid range is 1 to 360 minutes. The TiltBridge clamps values outside that range.
settings.capacity_group_desc: How many readings can be held before the oldest are dropped. This sets how long an outage can last without losing data.
settings.max_records_desc: Valid range is 100 to {max}, which is what this device's flash can actually hold. At the current record size this reserves roughly {bytes} bytes.
settings.batch_size_desc: How many queued readings are uploaded per attempt. Valid range is 1 to 50. Lower this if uploads time out.
settings.enable_queue_desc: When unchecked, readings taken while offline are discarded instead of being stored.
settings.runway: With {tilts} Tilt(s) reporting, a total outage would fill the queue in about {duration}.
settings.persist_faster_than_push: Note: you are persisting every {persist} min but only sending every {push} min. While sending works nothing is stored, so this only makes an outage record finer than normal operation, and fills the queue faster.

recovery.description: An independent watchdog restarts the TiltBridge if the outbound sender stops responding while Bluetooth and the network are still working. Repeated send failures alone never trigger a restart.
recovery.stale_reboot_sec_desc: How long the sender heartbeat may go without an update before the device restarts itself. Valid range is 60 to 600 seconds.
recovery.enable_recovery_desc: Uncheck to report a stale sender on the About page without restarting the device.
recovery.enable_wifi_roam: Move off a weak access point
recovery.enable_wifi_roam_desc: When the average signal has been poor for ten minutes and a materially stronger access point exists on the same network, briefly drop the connection to move onto it. Useful where a repeater shares the SSID with the router, because the device otherwise associates with whichever it hears first and never reconsiders. Leave this off if you only have one access point - there is nothing to move to.

errors.invalid_interval: Snapshot interval must be between 1 and 360 minutes
errors.invalid_max_records: Maximum queued records must be between 100 and {max}
errors.invalid_batch_size: Batch size must be between 1 and 50
errors.invalid_stale_reboot: Stale sender timeout must be between 60 and 600 seconds

send_errors.banner_title: One or more send targets are reporting errors

error_short.code_9: Fermentrack: Invalid user or API key

error_detail.code_1: TiltBridge was unable to connect to this target. This could be caused by a DNS resolution failure, the server being unreachable, a connection timeout, or the connection being refused. Check that the target address is correct and that the server is accessible from the TiltBridge's network.
error_detail.code_2: The target rejected the request due to invalid or missing credentials. Check that your API key, username, or password are correct and have not expired.
error_detail.code_3: The target URL was not found. Check that the URL is correct and the service is still available at that address.
error_detail.code_4: The target server encountered an internal error. This is usually a temporary issue on the target's side. If it persists, check the target service's status page.
error_detail.code_5: The target rejected the request or required configuration is missing. Check that all configuration fields are filled in correctly.
error_detail.code_6: The target is rate limiting requests from TiltBridge. Try increasing the push frequency interval in the settings.
error_detail.code_7: An unexpected error occurred while communicating with this target. Check the target service's documentation or status page for details.
error_detail.code_8: TiltBridge was disconnected from the MQTT broker. Check that the broker address and port are correct, the broker is running, and any authentication credentials are valid.
error_detail.code_9: The configured username or API key was rejected by Fermentrack. Check that the username and API key are correct and match a valid account on the target Fermentrack install.
error_detail.code_10: The registration request sent to Fermentrack was malformed. This usually means the TiltBridge firmware or the Fermentrack version is out of date. Try updating both and re-registering.
error_detail.code_11: The device registration with Fermentrack is no longer valid. Try resetting the device ID on the Fermentrack configuration page to re-register.
error_detail.code_12: The configured Fermentrack user does not have a brewhouse. Complete the brewhouse setup in Fermentrack before connecting TiltBridge.
error_detail.unknown: An unexpected error occurred (code {code}). Check the settings for this target and ensure both TiltBridge and the target are up to date.

calibration.chart_placeholder_message: Chart will be displayed as calibration points are added

manual_coefficient_modal.title: Manual Coefficient Entry
manual_coefficient_modal.description: Enter calibration coefficients directly. The formula will be applied as: x0 + x1×(raw gravity) + x2×(raw gravity)²
